name: @zichan/sync-server
description: End-to-end-encrypted commit-replica server with accounts and administration

scripts.build: npm run build:dependencies && tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.mjs
scripts.maintenance: npm run build:dependencies && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node dist/maintenance.js
